steps.name: Verify build identity and refresh workspace links
Merge native coverage with original thresholds
Create runner profile
steps.run: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.mkdirSync('.tmp/verification-plan', { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync('.tmp/verification-plan/profile.json', JSON.stringify({ os: process.platform, arch: process.arch, nodeMajor: Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]), provider: 'none', platform: 'weapp', runnerClass: 'github-hosted' }));"

steps.name: Freeze complete task inventory and shard assignment
steps.run:
node --import tsx e2e/scripts/verification/cli.ts history --input=.tmp/verification-history --profile=.tmp/verification-plan/profile.json --repository="${{ github.repository }}" --workflow=.github/workflows/ci-e2e.yml --output=.tmp/verification-plan/history.json
node --import tsx e2e/scripts/verification/cli.ts plan --suite=ci-${{ inputs.mode }} --shards=4 --profile=.tmp/verification-plan/profile.json --history=.tmp/verification-plan/history.json --output=.tmp/verification-plan/plan.json
